summary: Verified bug fix: /api/ask-recipes and /api/suggest now return yield_text and ingredients_detailed with quantities; RecipeDetail renders the yield pill (data-testid='recipe-yield') and the ingredients-detailed section on both Ask flow and Scan flow. 3/3 new backend pytest cases pass and both Playwright E2E flows pass.

issues: 'Coach' link appears twice in the top navigation (between Analyze/Saved and again between Ask/About). Pre-existing, unrelated to this bug fix but worth cleaning up.

Hero recipe image area sometimes renders empty (only the emoji bubble visible) — likely image_query lookup fallback not firing on some queries. Pre-existing (recipeImage lib), not part of this bug fix.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _build_ingredients_detailed lowercases 'name' — RecipeDetail.jsx already applies CSS `capitalize`, so display is fine, but any future exact-match logic should keep case-insensitivity in mind.

RecipeDetail conditional for the legacy 'You have' block: `!(recipe.ingredients_detailed?.length > 0 && (recipe.missing_ingredients || []).length === 0)` — correctly hides the redundant chip list on the Ask flow while keeping it for Scan/suggest. Logic verified via both flows.

yield_text defaults to '' in Pydantic model — LLM occasionally could return empty; endpoints don't currently reject that. Consider a fallback to `Serves {servings}` server-side if yield_text is blank (frontend already falls back visually).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests at /app/backend/tests/test_recipes_detailed.py cover yield_text + ingredients_detailed for /ask-recipes (cookies, banana bread) and /suggest regression. LLM calls take 15-30s each — allow >=180s timeouts. Ask flow confirmed to hide the legacy 'You have' block (since missing_ingredients is always empty on Ask); Scan flow still shows it plus the new ingredients list.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug root cause was that both /api/suggest and /api/ask-recipes prompts previously requested only a flat lowercase ingredient string list with no quantities, and no yield hint. Fix: extended the Recipe Pydantic model with `ingredients_detailed: List[IngredientDetail]` and `yield_text: str`; the LLM prompts now REQUIRE these fields with example quantity formats and yield strings. Frontend RecipeDetail.jsx renders the new yield pill and detailed ingredient list. Verified end-to-end.
